NEBULA GENERATOR

Shape the unknown

Six bounded 3D forms. Approach, enter and leave each cloud in the isolated flight preview.

How this volume is built

A ray intersects each distant cloud before sampling its layered 3D density. Domain warping forms filaments; denser dust absorbs light; front-to-back integration creates depth and luminous gas. Clouds occupy bounded volumes separated by dark space. The camera moves through their actual density fields; this is not a zoomed background image. Travel is cinematically accelerated; colours and emission remain artistic.

The renderer is a standalone WebGPU module. No nebula is added to the credits until a look is chosen.
